def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    space = groups[1]
    time_part = groups[2]
    timestamp = int(date_part + time_part)
    layout = [len(space)]
    return {'stored': [timestamp], 'layout': layout}

def inverse(record):
    layout = record['layout']
    timestamp = str(record['stored'][0])
    date_part = timestamp[:6]
    time_part = timestamp[6:]
    space = ' ' * layout[0]
    return f"{date_part}{space}{time_part}"
